meta.source: Blizzard Game Data journal-encounter + Wowhead tooltip API
meta.readMe: Ability text and damage magnitudes come from Wowhead's tooltip endpoint, which is the only source carrying tuned numbers for this tier -- Blizzard's /data/wow/spell/<id> returns 404 for these ids and the in-game journal text ships 'X' placeholders. A magnitude here is ONE difficulty's value and the endpoint does not say which; cross-check against measured damage taken in profiles/<spec>-<difficulty>.json before quoting it as a Mythic number.

encounter.name: Vashnik the Malignant
encounter.description: Within The Chamber of Virulence, Vashnik the Malignant distills Ula'tek's venoms into ever more lethal forms. The creature lurks in its noxious chamber, brewing foul toxins to empower its brood.

notes.title: Overview
notes.bodyText:
Upon reaching 100 energy, Vashnik [Imbibes] from the nearest two fountains, increasing his affinity to them. These fountains erupt with vapor, bringing forth living venom that crawl toward the Malignant Cavity in the center of the chamber.

Should a living venom reach its destination, a [Malignant Burst] occurs.
bullets:

$bullet; Living venoms explode in [Malignant Bursts] unless destroyed.

$bullet; The initial Clotting Venom is protected by [Sanguineous Fortitude].

abilities.title: Imbibe
abilities.description:
Vashnik draws power from two nearby fountains, infusing himself with their power and gaining an application of Toxic Vapor.

Each fountain bursts forth in an expulsion of toxins and creates living venoms that crawl toward the Malignant Cavity.

abilities.title: Malignance
abilities.description: The totem sends a wave of poison, inflicting 666725 Nature damage and an additional 208352 Nature damage every 2 sec for 1 min to all players. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Blood Infusion
abilities.description:
Vashnik empowers himself with blood venom, bolstering his next cast of Imbibe. 

Increases the damage of Hemo Expulsion by 100% and the maximum health of Clotting Venoms by 50% for 1.5 min. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Hemo Expulsion
abilities.description: Vashnik draws venom from the Fountain of Blood, inflicting 108343 Shadow damage to all players.

abilities.title: Sanguineous Fortitude
abilities.description: Clotting Venom is fortified as it emerges, protecting it from crowd control effects until destroyed.

abilities.title: Splitting Clot
abilities.description: Clotting Venom splits upon dying, creating smaller Clotting Venom.

abilities.title: Shadow Infusion
abilities.description:
Vashnik empowers himself with shadow venom, bolstering his next cast of Imbibe.

Increases the damage of Gloom Expulsion by 100% and the maximum health of Shrouded Venoms by 50% for 1.5 min. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Gloom Expulsion
abilities.description: Vashnik draws venom from the Fountain of Shadow, inflicting 108343 Shadow damage to all players.

abilities.title: Miasmic Coating
abilities.description: Shrouded Venom is protected by a Miasmic Coating that absorbs 100% of its max health in damage.

abilities.title: Umbral Ejection
abilities.description: Shrouded Venoms burst when destroyed, spraying shadow venom that inflicts 541714 Shadow damage to players within 3 yards of its impact locations.

abilities.title: Flame Infusion
abilities.description:
Vashnik empowers himself with flame venom, bolstering his next cast of Imbibe. 

Increases the damage of Conflagrating Expulsion by 100% and the maximum health of Burning Venoms by 50% for 1.5 min. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Conflagrating Expulsion
abilities.description: Vashnik draws venom from the Fountain of Flame, inflicting 108343 Fire damage to all players.

abilities.title: Burning Presence
abilities.description: Burning Venom pulses with flame, inflicting 33336 Fire damage to all players every 3 sec.

abilities.title: Caustic Surge
abilities.description: Burning Venoms explode when destroyed, inflicting 100009 Fire damage to all players3 sec. This effect stacks. [.]

abilities.title: Hardened Venom
abilities.description: The venom hardens after sixty seconds, and becomes immune to crowd control effects, and gains 50% increased movement speed.

abilities.title: Toxic Vapor
abilities.description: Toxic vapor fills the dank air of the chamber, inflicting 10001 Nature damage every 2 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Malignant Burst
abilities.description: Living venoms burst upon reaching the Malignant Cavity, inflicting 1666813 Nature damage to all players and an additional 333363 Nature damage every 3 sec for 30 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Malignant Catalyst
abilities.description: Vashnik congeals an orb of venom above the Malignant Cavity and then explodes it, inflicting 320862 Nature damage to all players and launching Catalytic Bile.

abilities.title: Catalytic Bile
abilities.description:
A toxic spray that inflicts 283224 Nature damage to players within 6 yards of the impact locations. 

If Catalytic Bile fails to hit at least one player, 666725 Nature damage is inflicted to all players instead.

abilities.title: Plague Froth
abilities.description: Vashnik coats his victims in a corrosive venom that inflicts 166681 Plague damage to players within 4.5 yards every 1 sec for 6 sec. When the aura expires, Plague Waves erupt from the target in cardinal directions.

abilities.title: Plague Wave
abilities.description: Waves of plague venom erupt from the target, inflicting 666725 Plague damage to players hit.

abilities.title: Dripping Fangs
abilities.description: Vashnik bites into his current target, inflicting 2083517 Physical damage and an additional 250022 Nature damage every 2 sec for 32 sec. Increases Physical damage taken by 200%. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Adaptive Infection
abilities.description: Vashnik infects several players with toxins, according to his current infusions.

abilities.title: Siphoning Infection
abilities.description:
Vashnik infects several players with a blood venom that inflicts 58338 Shadow damage every 1.5 sec and absorbs the next 1065737  healing.

While the infection lasts, healing received is reduced by 100%, and the target periodically casts Siphon Blood to nearby players.

abilities.title: Siphon Blood
abilities.description: Inflicting 125011 Shadow damage to nearby allies, and healing 28420 for each ally hit every 1.5 sec.

abilities.title: Thinned Blood
abilities.description: Your blood is being drained faster than expected, increasing damage taken from Siphon Blood by 500%.

abilities.title: Exploding Infection
abilities.description: Vashnik infects players with a flame venom that inflicts 25002 Fire damage every 1.5 sec. Upon removal, the infected player will erupt in a Caustic Explosion.

abilities.title: Caustic Explosion
abilities.description: The infected player explodes, inflicting 233354 Fire damage to all players.

abilities.title: Stygian Infection
abilities.description: Vashnik infects several players with a shadow venom that inflicts 58338 Shadow damage every 1.5 sec and absorbs the next 1420983 healing. While the infection lasts, the infected player periodically casts Stygian Burst.

abilities.title: Stygian Burst
abilities.description: An eruption of dark venom that inflicts 583385 Shadow damage to players within 3.5 yards of the impact location.
